entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Another hold. I just want to return something, how hard can it be?!
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return this piece of junk I bought. Your sizing chart is a complete lie and I am not happy.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed with your purchase. I can definitely look into this for you. Could you provide me with your order number?
It's VF9827-5. I bought a cycling jersey and it's the wrong size. I mean, it's so ridiculously tight I can barely breathe in it! This is false advertising.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. Thank you for that. Just so I can find the right solution, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault with the material or a preference on the fit?

What kind of a question is that? I just told you! It's too tight! I ordered a Large and it fits like a Small. This is your company's fault. I want a full refund and I want it now. Get me your manager, I don't have time for these games.

I understand your frustration, sir, and I sincerely apologize that the sizing wasn't as you expected. There's no need to speak with a manager, I can absolutely handle this for you. I see here you received the order 9 days ago.
Yeah, and I've been trying to get through for two days! I'm about to light you up on social media if this isn't fixed in the next five minutes.

I can assure you we can resolve this right now. Because it's a jersey, it falls under our 90-day return policy. Since the issue is the fit, we have two simple options. We can process a full refund, or I can set up an exchange for a different size immediately. There would be no cost to you for the exchange shipping.
Oh. So you can just... send me the right one?

Yes, absolutely. I can process an exchange for an XL right now if you'd like. I will email you a prepaid return label for the jersey that's too tight. As soon as you drop it off with the carrier, we'll dispatch the new size to you.
Fine. Yeah, do that. The exchange for an XL sounds right. Make sure it actually gets done.

Consider it done. I've just processed the exchange. The return label is on its way to your email inbox now. You should see it within the next couple of minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Again, I do apologize for the inconvenience with the sizing. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
